Package neqsim.process.equipment.heatexchanger

Class SarirAtmosphericCrudeHeatingCase

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.heatexchanger.SarirAtmosphericCrudeHeatingCase
public final class SarirAtmosphericCrudeHeatingCase extends Object
Source-bounded crude heating train for the public Sarir atmospheric-column feed.

The case preserves the published crude rate, atmospheric-column feed temperature, and absolute pressure from SarirAtmosphericReference. The source does not document a refinery preheat train, furnace pressure loss, efficiency, fuel, or emission factors. Callers must therefore provide those engineering choices explicitly through SarirAtmosphericCrudeHeatingCase.HeatingInputs. This is an executable screening case, not a reconstruction of the Sarir heater system.

The configured train contains a sensible Heater followed by a FiredHeater. It deliberately excludes heat-exchanger topology, utility streams, fouling, radiant/convection sections, combustion chemistry, and plant calibration.

    • create

      public static SarirAtmosphericCrudeHeatingCase create(String name, double[] cutSpecificGravity, double[] cutMolarMassKgPerMol, SarirAtmosphericCrudeHeatingCase.HeatingInputs heatingInputs)
      Create a configured but unsolved crude heating train.
      Parameters:
      name - non-blank case name
      cutSpecificGravity - specific gravity for each of the 18 source-derived cuts
      cutMolarMassKgPerMol - molar mass for each cut, in kg/mol
      heatingInputs - explicit source-unreported heating, pressure-loss, fuel, and emission inputs
      Returns:
      configured heating train
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if heatingInputs is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the name, profiles, or heating inputs are invalid
